description: This is a Python source file for a Gemini Live Grounding Metadata bot, which integrates various components such as speech analysis, web search, and a pipeline for processing frames and user interactions. It defines classes and functions to set up a conversational AI with grounding metadata processing and real-time web search capabilities.

classes.name: GroundingMetadataProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor that captures and logs grounding metadata from Gemini Live API responses, specifically handling LLMSearchResponseFrame instances.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GroundingMetadataProcessor, setting the grounding count to zero.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame, logging grounding metadata if the frame is an LLMSearchResponseFrame, and then pushes the frame downstream.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the Gemini Live Grounding Metadata test bot, including creating tools, initializing the LLM service, setting up the processing pipeline, and handling client connection events.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creating the transport and starting the bot process.
